name: St. Paul's Church, Macao, before it was burnt down, and part of Mr. Turner's house
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of the college and church of S. Paulo, the principal church of Macau, most which was destroyed by fire two months after this drawing was executed; the façade remains.
